items.cite: Carl E. Schorske, *Fin-de-Siècle Vienna: Politics and Culture* (Vintage, 1980 edition).
items.note: A cultural and political history of Vienna that places musical developments beside the city’s other arts and institutions.

items.cite: Carl Dahlhaus, *Between Romanticism and Modernism*, translated by Mary Whittall (University of California Press, 1989 edition).
items.note: Studies late-nineteenth-century music at the boundary between inherited Romantic practices and modernism.

items.cite: Jim Samson, ed., *The Cambridge History of Nineteenth-Century Music* (Cambridge University Press, 2001).
items.note: Combines repertory studies with aesthetics, institutions, nationalism, popular culture and the emergence of the avant-garde.
